title: Mostrar en Live qué trabajo espera una capacidad específica
mission: Make project backlog legibility honest when unresolved work is capability-specific. Project declared required_capabilities into the static Live feed and compact project UI so browser/publication work is visible as requiring a suitable worker rather than appearing as missing work or silently driving duplicate planning. Do not infer that a declared capability is globally unavailable.
definition_of_done: Static Live feed exposes bounded required_capabilities for unresolved project jobs and excludes terminal jobs from the unresolved capability-requirement count.
Project/Production UI can distinguish ordinary ready/active work from unresolved work that declares special runtime capabilities, using compact human-readable wording.
The projection never labels a capability globally unavailable merely because one worker lacks it; it reports the declared requirement only.
Fixture for Prometeo Live shows the narrow-browser verifier and real-publication canary as browser-capability work while repository-test work remains separately executable.
No client-side GitHub API traversal is introduced; existing static-feed architecture remains the data source.
6m/10m liveness semantics and Current/Human Accepted/Served authority remain unchanged.
